description: Hand-verified records for landmark works missing from the serving generation, merged at query time (openalex_semantic_search/supplement.py). At most 500 records. Every record must list the https sources its metadata was checked against and the date it was checked; copy fields only from those sources, never from memory. A work the generation already holds is skipped at startup, so remove an entry once a rebuilt generation contains it.
